skill.body:
---
name: task-queue
description: "Explains the Maestro task queue: the numbered prompt files under .claude/maestro-tasks/, the blockedBy cascade and status.json that decide which are ready, the PostToolUse hook that checks TaskCreate calls against the selected workflow's success path, the two implementations (tasks.ts and maestro-tasks.cjs) that must agree, and the claims subsystem (claims.ts / maestro-task-status.cjs) that lets two concurrent sessions claim different ready tasks. Use when working on /to-maestro-tasks, the /maestro-tasks route or the validation hook, when a task won't unblock, when a close from the UI and one from the orchestrator disagree, or when two sessions might grab the same task."
metadata:
  type: concept-skill
  version: "4.1"
  last-update: bd96a4069821973fff688813fe28d7d2d7bef401
---

# Task queue

A queue of ready-to-run prompts that `/to-maestro-tasks` writes under
`<project>/.claude/maestro-tasks/`, one numbered markdown file per vertical slice
(`001-verify-workflow-canvas-interactions.md`). The Maestro orchestrator picks them up, classifies
each, and runs it; the desktop app's `/maestro-tasks` route shows the same queue.

The files are workflow-agnostic prompts — a title, what to build, and acceptance criteria — not
instructions to a specific agent. Classification is the orchestrator's job at run time. `status.json`
in the same directory holds `{ status, blockedBy }` per file; `blockedBy` is parsed out of the task
file and cascades, so closing one task can make several ready at once — see
[Task files and the cascade](sub-concepts/task-files.md).

## Two implementations that must agree

`apps/maestro/src/core/tasks.ts` (the app) and `plugins/maestro/scripts/lib/maestro-tasks.cjs` (the
orchestrator) both implement the cascade. **`maestro-tasks.cjs` is the one lib file that is NOT
generated** — it has no `plugin-entries/` source, and is hand-maintained in sync with `tasks.ts`
precisely so a close from the UI and one from the orchestrator cannot disagree about which tasks are
ready. Changing the cascade in one place and not the other is the failure mode this arrangement
exists to prevent.

**A second pair, added by `066`, does the same for claims** — `claims.ts` against hand-written logic
inside `maestro-task-status.cjs`; see [Claims](sub-concepts/task-claims.md).

## The validation hook

`maestro-validate-tasks.js` is a `PostToolUse` hook on `TaskCreate` that checks each created task
against the selected workflow's success path and warns — **always non-blocking, always advisory** —
on a mismatch or a skipped step. See [TaskCreate validation](sub-concepts/task-validation.md).

## Files

| File | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `<project>/.claude/maestro-tasks/NNN-*.md` | The prompts. |
| `<project>/.claude/maestro-tasks/status.json` | Status + `blockedBy` per file. |
| `<project>/.claude/maestro-tasks/views/` | Generated plan pages (`.html`, `157`), not tasks. Listers read only the `.md` files directly in `maestro-tasks/`, so a page here is never listed; no hook removes the folder. |
| `apps/maestro/src/core/tasks.ts` | `tasksDirFor`, `parseBlockedBy`, `listTasks`, `closeTask`, `deleteTask`, `extractPostMortemSection` (cut by the shared `sectionOf`, also used by `parseBlockedBy`), `setTaskEpic`, `readTaskTracker`, `tailTasks` (the live-update tail). |
| `<project>/.claude/postmortems.log` | Committed history of deleted tickets' `## Post-Mortem` sections. |
| `plugins/maestro/scripts/lib/maestro-tasks.cjs` | Hand-maintained twin. |
| `apps/maestro/src/core/claims.ts` | `claimTask`, `releaseTask`, `readClaims`, `isSessionLive`, `ensureClaimsDir`, `claimSessionName`, `deleteClaimIfAny` (`066`); `tasks.ts` re-exports `claimTask`/`releaseTask`/`claimsDirFor`. |
| `apps/maestro/src/core/session-heartbeat.ts` | `141`: `heartbeatVerdict` (the liveness rule `isSessionLive` applies first), `heartbeatTick` and the process probes behind the detached watcher that `plugins/maestro/scripts/maestro-session-heartbeat.js` (SessionStart) spawns. See [Claims](sub-concepts/task-claims.md#the-session-heartbeat-141). |
| `<project>/.claude/maestro-tasks/claims/` | Per-task claim files (`066`); git-ignored, deleted on uninstall. |
| `<project>/.claude/maestro-tasks/views/` | Generated HTML plan pages (`172`); git-ignored by the committed-mode `# Maestro` block, regenerated on demand, never committed. |
| `apps/maestro/src/core/epics.ts` | Epic state, membership (`setTaskEpic` writes the tracker's `epic` field) and the report inbox (`084`), cross-epic notes and dependencies (`085`), the manager's spawn list `readyTasks` (`125`); `176`: the `watch` pointer lines (`newInboxAnnouncements`, `inboxPointer`), the containerized wording (`deliveryWords`, `reviewDeliveryWords`) and `MANAGER_MESSAGE_MARKER`; shipped as generated `lib/maestro-epic.cjs` behind `scripts/maestro-epic.cjs`. `173`: review ids (`mNNN`) are allocated from the log plus the inbox and claimed by an exclusive `inbox/mNNN-<task>.md` file, as report ids are. |
| `apps/maestro/src/core/epic-boundary.ts` | `158`'s `boundary` command: whether an epic's start or end skills are due, the once-only claim, and the scope file; its git calls are read-only. `173`: the end check counts unacknowledged inbox files by handle, including ones the log no longer lists. See [Epics](sub-concepts/epics.md#epic-boundaries-boundary-158). |
| `<project>/.claude/epics/<slug>/` | `EPIC.md`, `state.json`, `inbox/rNNN-<task>.md` (`084`), `inbox/nNNN-from-<epic>.md` (`085`). |
| `plugins/maestro/skills/maestro-manager/` | The published skill that runs one epic and resumes after restarts (`084`); spawns workers in herdr tabs from `ready` (`125`). |
| `plugins/maestro/skills/maestro-install/references/herdr.md` | The user-facing herdr setup guide the manager's fallback points to (`125`). |
| `apps/maestro/src/core/worker-runtime.ts` | `175`: `resolveWorkerRuntime` (`worker_runtime`), `dockerLaunchCommandFor`, the read-only mount list, `filterSettingsLocal`, the token reader and the image tag inputs. `176`: user-scope plugins baked into the image (`userSettingsJsonFor`), `imagePluginProbe`/`parseProbeOutput`/`missingPluginMessage`, `isContainerWorker`. `179`: `detectToolchain` (package manager, playwright browsers, apt from `verify_command`), `packageManagerInstall`, `refreshRuntimeWords` (the host-only refresh wording). `180`: `isMarketplaceExcluded` (no `.claude/epics` in the image), `PROJECT_LABEL`/`projectLabelFor`, `planPrune`/`formatPrune`. Plans and writes the build context; spawns nothing. See [Epics](sub-concepts/epics.md), "The docker runtime (`175`)". |
| `plugins/maestro/scripts/maestro-worker-runtime.cjs` | `175`: the `image`, `run` and `prune` CLI, the one place that spawns `docker`, `claude` or `git` for the container runtime. Copied into projects as `.claude/scripts/maestro-worker-runtime.cjs`. `176`: `run` probes the image for each enabled plugin and refuses one that lacks it. `180`: `prune [--dry-run]` removes stopped worker containers and this project's labelled superseded images (exit 1 on a refused removal or failed query). |
| `plugins/maestro/scripts/maestro-validate-tasks.js` | The `PostToolUse` hook. |
| `plugins/maestro/scripts/maestro-task-status.cjs` | Status CLI (`sync`, `done`, `claim`, `release`, `worktree` (`074`), `freeform-check` (`098`: the worktree decision for a freeform run with no task file; sees live freeform sessions via session.json, not claims; `103`: with another live session it creates a `freeform-<id>` worktree, and `merge` accepts that branch name), `merge` (`076`), `mark-merged <task>` (`146`: clears a done task's `unmerged` flag after a hand merge); `done` for a worktree task sets `unmerged` and prints a "done but NOT merged" notice, see [Task files](sub-concepts/task-files.md)); `170`: `merge` refuses unless the main checkout is on the default branch with no tracked changes outside Maestro's state, runs without a worktree, and prints a `VERIFY` line after merging; `switch-back` returns the main checkout to the default branch with `!` hand-offs, see [Finishing](sub-concepts/task-claims.md#finishing-a-worktree-task-076)). When every conflicting file on `merge` is a generated plugin lib or its tracked `.claude/scripts/lib` mirror, it names the resolution (resolve `src/core`, run `pnpm refresh:runtime` to rebuild the libs and copy them over the mirrors, run `parity.test.ts`, commit, merge again) instead of leaving a hand-merge of bundle text; if any other file also conflicts it prints no hint (`082`). `083` added: `plan`/`plan-step`/`plan-show` (the orchestrator's success-path tracker in session.json for when TaskCreate is unavailable — `done` refuses while a recorded plan has an unfinished step), `handoff-issues` (prints and clears the SubagentStop hook's verdict/HANDOFF findings), and to `merge`: a dirty-worktree refusal also prints the worktree path and a suggested commit (the user approves it; never auto-committed), a refusal listing untracked main-checkout files that collide with the branch (each marked identical-to-branch or different), and a `SANDBOX-BLOCKED` report with the exact `!` command when git cannot write into the main checkout. `163`: `merge` also refuses while ignored paths exist only in the worktree (`--accept-ignored` waives it), `done` prints that list, and `worktree`/`freeform-check` copy git-excluded nested `.claude` directories in. `173`: `merge` reads `done` from the branch's own tracker (a task committed on its branch in the main checkout), merges `status.json` itself, resolves a conflict in that file alone, and refuses on any other locally modified file the merge would overwrite (named, identical or different, with the resolving command; nothing discarded). It also keeps the set-aside tracker in a backup file in the git directory, re-applies it right after the merge, and refuses while an earlier merge's backup is still on disk; never copy that backup over the tracker (see [Finishing](sub-concepts/task-claims.md#finishing-a-worktree-task-076)). |

## Relationships

- `maestro-architecture` — the orchestrator that consumes the queue, and the `success-path` the hook
  validates against.
- `plugin-libs-parity` (in `apps/maestro/.claude/skills`) — the generation rule this file is the
  documented exception to.
- `log-view` (in `apps/maestro/.claude/skills`) — the Session Log tail this queue's live-update
  pipeline mirrors: main-process poller, subscribe/unsubscribe IPC, single-owner-per-window tail,
  retargeted on project switch. The two are separate implementations by design, not a shared module
  — see [Live updates](sub-concepts/live-task-updates.md).
